name: Mogami Ruu
source: The main protagonist of the game. Ruu deeply respects her older sister Yuuho and is completely alarmed when somebody sends her a picture of her masturbating through mail. Seeing the terrifying picture, Ruu decides to take action, find the anonymous sender and make him pay for his deed. However, the gears of a terrifying tragedy have already started moving...
